correctness.rationale: The exact conditional Bernoulli hole law follows from Poisson zero probabilities and Gaussian nondegeneracy. Conditional Chernoff/Bernstein plus Borel–Cantelli establish strong count asymptotics and finite holes. The product-Laplace limit identifies the pre-existing Dickman critical distribution. Mainardi Laplace asymptotics and integral comparisons yield annealed constants. Summable covariance trace ensures a genuine square-integrable spherical field. Included independent finite checker passed 481 tests; all infinite steps are analytic.

value.rationale: The object is a natural exactly observable gap in harmonic support of a newly introduced random-field family, and logarithmic rates are the canonical scaling at which hole probabilities have power tails. The result provides sharp almost-sure and expected counts, a nondegenerate random observable exponent law, an almost-sure versus conditional integrability transition, and a precise classical critical distribution, none inferable from ordinary second-order angular power spectra alone.
